context:
Thread a ledger object through the existing apply_* hook sequence rather than
re-architecting adapters; session SETs hook at the connection.execute wrapper
where one exists.
description:
From the 2026-07-12 tuning review, findings C1, C5 (capture side), R6
(evidence pinned to commit acfb8992). GATED on ADR-1
(tuning-adr-trust-and-hash-semantics-20260712).

Today the bundle records intent as fact: tunings_applied is the requested
config's to_dict() and validation_status "APPLIED" certifies only that a
metadata-table INSERT succeeded (platforms/base/adapter.py:743-747). The base
apply_unified_tuning is a silent no-op (platforms/base/tuning_config.py:45-66).
Session-level SETs applied by configure_for_benchmark (ClickHouse OLAP pack,
StarRocks query settings) are captured nowhere. Rerun drift-detection is blind
to platform optimizations and unique/check constraints
(core/tuning/metadata.py:247-256) and never feeds published bundles;
FAILED_TO_SAVE surfaces for benign read-only/in-memory conditions.

Build, per ADR-1's decided semantics:
- an applied-statement ledger: every tuning-relevant statement the adapter
  actually executes (DDL clauses, post-load statements, session SETs) appended
  during execution and exported alongside the requested config;
- the applied-ledger hash (per ADR-1);
- honest validation_status semantics (e.g. applied_verified /
  applied_unverified / noop / failed) replacing the metadata-write proxy, with
  FAILED_TO_SAVE downgraded to a non-alarming metadata-persistence note;
- drift-validation results routed into the bundle where ADR-1 says they belong.

anti_patterns.dont: No post-hoc reconstruction of the ledger from config
anti_patterns.why: it must be produced by the execution path

anti_patterns.dont: repurpose the old APPLIED string with new semantics silently; new status vocabulary, documented mapping

deferrals.summary: DataFrame runtime-tuning ledger parity (threads/memory/write-layout as applied observations, not just config blobs)

deferrals.reason: Out of w2 named-adapter scope (duckdb/clickhouse/starrocks/databricks/cloud_spark). Native spark.py/lakesail.py apply AQE/CBO via connection.conf.set(); snowpark_connect.py via self._session.sql() - both bypass the wrapped execute()/cursor().execute(), so the ledger stays empty and derives 'noop'. Under-reports only (never a false 'applied'); degrades safe. Flagged by adversarial review.
deferrals.summary: Capture native Spark (connection.conf.set) and Snowpark (session.sql) session-tuning into the applied ledger

deferrals.reason: w3 sub-item premised on 'where ADR-1 says they belong', but ADR-001 is silent on a drift-result bundle location (no design target). Orthogonal to the applied-ledger (rerun/reused-DB concern via platforms/base/validation.py:_validate_database_tunings), needs a schema-placement decision. Deferred to keep the soundness-critical ledger PR focused rather than half-bake an underspecified routing.
deferrals.summary: Route rerun drift-validation results (MetadataValidationResult) into the published bundle

preserves.behavior: Benchmark execution must never fail because ledger capture fails (capture degrades, run continues, degradation recorded)

work_units.evidence: Built benchbox/core/tuning/applied_ledger.py: AppliedTuningLedger (record/record_dropped/overall_status/applied_ledger_hash/to_payload), all-lowercase vocab (not_applicable/noop/applied_unverified/applied_verified[reserved for introspection-receipts]/failed/not_validated), LEGACY_STATUS_MAP, transparent RecordingConnection+cursor for execution-path capture. Smoke-tested: applied_unverified/failed/noop/not_applicable derivations, 64-hex hash, transparent delegation. Aligns ADR-001 hash canonical form (sort_keys+compact, ordered list).
work_units.summary: Design the ledger data model + capture hooks (adapter records statements at execution time; base no-op records 'noop'); align with ADR-1 record

work_units.evidence: Instrumented apply/session paths: duckdb.apply_unified_tuning + base apply_standard_unified_tuning wrap the connection (RecordingConnection PHASE_DDL) capturing CREATE INDEX / OPTIMIZE / constraint hooks; session SETs captured by wrapping the configure_for_benchmark connection at adapter.py (clickhouse _apply_setting_with_validation + starrocks cursor.execute both drive the passed connection); databricks _applied_layout_operations folded PHASE_POST_LOAD before session SETs (chronology); cloud_spark _spark_config recorded PHASE_SESSION. Readback SELECTs filtered out (review F3). Native spark/snowpark deferred.
work_units.summary: Instrument the SQL adapters with real tuning paths (duckdb, clickhouse, starrocks, databricks, cloud_spark) plus session SETs from configure_for_benchmark in every mode including baseline

work_units.evidence: applied_tuning_ledger + applied_ledger_hash on BenchmarkResults/builder/result_factory; build_applied_ledger_payload -> .applied.json companion (anonymized via _anonymize_applied_payload dropping statement/error/table for public exports, review F2); loader reconstruct + integrity_validator exclusion; applied_ledger_hash in build_tuning_payload + _build_tuning_summary next to requested_config_hash. New honest validation_status (not_applicable/noop/applied_unverified/applied_verified[reserved]/failed) replaces APPLIED/FAILED_TO_SAVE; FAILED_TO_SAVE downgraded to tuning_metadata_saved note. Drift-validation-routing sub-item deferred (ADR-1 silent on target).
work_units.summary: Export ledger + applied hash into bundle/companion; implement new validation_status semantics; route drift-validation results per ADR-1
